prose: Old school deep-dive conspiracy researcher Brian S. Staveley joins InnerVerse to discuss the ever growing snowball of strangeness known as "The Mandela Effect." Is the past changing? Is reality mutable? We look at the theorized changes in consensus reality, ranging from Mr Rogers to alterations in geography. Particle accelerators, advanced technology emerging in the more distant past, and shifts in brand names and logos are just some of the topics on the table.
ext: We dig into the why and the how of ME's, exiting the reincarnation cycle by breaking the creation/simulation, COVID ME's, Biblical edits, Anatomy changes, disputation of the CERN = ME narrative, Alchenomics as a possible ME vector, and how Brian took 14 flights during lockdowns without covering his face.
